name: com.gamecore.content.compiler
description: Unity-free Game Core V1 content compiler core: it validates catalog description documents (duplicate ids, unknown schemas, unsupported required features) and emits deterministic generated C# catalogs with stable keyed registrations, generated serializers, closed generic roots and a catalog fingerprint. Editor-only (both asmdefs are Editor-platform). Its only local dependency is com.gamecore.contracts.
